words.title: Dublin nightlife strategy faces calls for more action
words.body:
Ireland is still “behind” other countries when it comes to developing its night-time economy, according to Dublin’s Night-Time Economy Adviser, Ray O’Donoghue.

Speaking two years after Dublin’s Night-Time Economy Strategy was launched, O’Donoghue said progress is being made, but called for night-time issues to be taken more seriously by policymakers. RTÉ
